description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker glm-5.3-flash recipe, which now serves NVIDIA's GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local (ModelOpt mixed FP4 checkpoint of Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash, quantization-aware distillation; NVIDIA Open Model Agreement, informational, base model MIT; checkpoint revision 76348ddb, about 178 GB of weights; this replaces local-inference-lab's GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-Spark that upstream served before) on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (--exp-b12x lane, nightly-20261102, digest pinned, built from spark-vllm-docker b7f6b4cd) with upstream's launch: modelopt_mixed quantization, B12X attention, MoE and linear backends, b12x load format, FP8 KV cache with block size 256, hybrid mamba cache mode align, chunked prefill and prefix caching, MTP speculative decoding with five tokens (humming drafter MoE backend, B12X attention), glm45 reasoning and glm47 tool-call parsers, 500,000-token context, four sequences, 4,096 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults; the creator lowered it from 0.87), with the upstream RoCE all-reduce, NCCL buffer, A16 MoE FP4 and ahead-of-time compilation environment and PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF per_process_memory_fraction:0.8 to bound the CUDA reservation during A16 preparation. Upstream no longer sets the pipeline-parallel size or the InstantTensor loader variables, so neither is passed. Upstream's kv_cache_memory_bytes default (8G) is not used by its launch command and is not applied. The recipe is cluster-only upstream (two Sparks). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.8 with no explicit KV pool, as in eugr's recipes/glm-5.3-flash.yaml at b7f6b4cd. The steady per-node peak is 0.8 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 10.4 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash FP4-Local B12X MTP vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
